systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Liquefied Subcritical Dimethyl Ether (sDME) Dewatering & Lipid Extraction Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Subcritical Liquefied Solvent Extraction Skid (ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 1 & 2 / NFPA 58 / ATEX Zone 1 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 & EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: Counter-Current Multi-Stage Liquefied sDME Extraction Column coupled with In-Line Hermetic Vapor Recompression Compressor and Flashing Calandria
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm) with Solid Hastelloy C-276 Impellers and PTFE/Kalrez Chemically Inert Elastomers
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual ASME UV Certified Safety Relief Valves, In-Line Fast-Acting Rupture Discs, Triple-Redundant Lower Explosive Limit (LEL) Catalytic Sensors, and Automatic Emergency N2 Inerting Cascade
systemArchitectures.description: Continuous, low-temperature dewatering and lipid extraction skid utilizing liquefied subcritical dimethyl ether (sDME, 0.5–0.85 MPa, 20–35°C). Dissolves water (up to 7.8 wt%) and neutral lipids simultaneously from wet pastes (80–92% moisture) without prior thermal drying, achieving >97% thermal energy savings.

systemArchitectures.name: Aseptic Wet Microalgae sDME Lipid Harvester & Dewatering Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Nutraceutical & Single-Cell Oil Sanitary Extraction Unit (FDA 21 CFR § 173.357 / USDA Organic Compliant / 3-A 63-04)
systemArchitectures.technology: High-Efficiency Continuous Perforated-Plate Pulsed Column with Hermetic Rotary Vane Recompression Loop and Sub-Micron Candle Filters
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Passivated AISI 316L Product Wetted Surfaces with Sanitary Tri-Clamp Ferrules and FFKM Perfluoroelastomer Diaphragms
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Continuous Flame Ionization Detection (FID) Monitoring, Automatic ESD Overpressure Cutoff, and Explosion-Proof Nitrogen Purge Enclosures
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered for high-moisture Chlorella, Nannochloropsis, and Spirulina pastes. Extracts high-value omega-3 EPA/DHA fatty acids, carotenoids, and neutral triacylglycerols at ambient temperatures without cell-baking, leaving intact water-soluble algal protein powders.

systemArchitectures.name: Industrial Byproduct Whey Fat & Brewers Spent Yeast Valorizer
systemArchitectures.classification: Circular Economy Food Upcycling Skid (EU Directive 2009/32/EC / 3-A Sanitary 63-04 / EHEDG Cleanability)
systemArchitectures.technology: Continuous Counter-Current Co-Axial Tube Extractor with Flash Evaporation Calandria and Reciprocating Sealed DME Vapor Compressor
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Duplex 2205 Stainless Steel Column with Electropolished AISI 316L Calandria Piping and PTFE Gaskets
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Safety Relief Valves Set to 1.2 MPa, Acoustic Leak Detectors, and Automatic Interlocked Vent-to-Flare Bypass Valve
systemArchitectures.description: Upcycles high-moisture industrial spent yeast and dairy whey centrifuge sludges. Dewaters sludge solids to <15% moisture while isolating high-purity phospholipids, sphingolipids, and neutral fats for infant formula and functional cosmetics.

systemArchitectures.name: Cleanroom Modular Explosion-Proof sDME Research & Pilot Unit
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Pilot Subcritical Solvent Validation Unit (Class 1 Div 1 Group D / ATEX Ex d IIB T4 / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: Precision Micro-Metering Multi-Port Sapphire Sight-Glass Column with Oil-Free Hermetic Scroll Compressor and Chilled Condenser Skid
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Monolithic Solid Hastelloy C-276 Passes with High-Pressure Double-Windowed Sapphire Sight Cells and Kalrez Seals
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Class 1 Div 1 Intrinsically Safe Control Console, High-Sensitivity Optical Flame Scanners, and Inert Halon-Free Clean Agent Extinguishing System
systemArchitectures.description: High-precision validation skid for pilot bio-refineries, university laboratories, and specialty lipids manufacturers measuring subcritical phase equilibria, distribution coefficients, and continuous recovery kinetics across novel food biomass.

feedMatrices.name: Wet Microalgal Paste (Chlorella vulgaris, 86.5% Initial Moisture, 18.2% Total Lipids)
feedMatrices.description: Intact wet single-cell microalgae paste. Liquefied sDME readily penetrates resilient algaenan and peptidoglycan cell walls, extracting water and neutral triacylglycerols in a single step without spray-dryer thermal lipid degradation or chlorophyll oxidation.

feedMatrices.name: Dairy Processing Acid Whey Centrifuge Sludge (82.0% Initial Moisture, 22.4% Phospholipids & Fats)
feedMatrices.description: High-fat dairy byproduct rich in milkfat globule membrane (MFGM) phospholipids and sphingomyelins. sDME extracts lipids cleanly without denaturing sensitive whey immunoglobulins and lactoferrin remaining in the dewatered protein cake.

feedMatrices.name: Brewery Spent Saccharomyces Yeast Slurry (84.0% Initial Moisture, 8.5% Membrane Lipids)
feedMatrices.description: Debittered brewing spent yeast. Simultaneous dewatering and sterol/fatty acid removal produces premium high-protein yeast extract for vegan culinary flavor bases and clinical peptide supplements.

feedMatrices.name: Fresh Soy Okara Fiber & Protein Pulp (78.5% Initial Moisture, 14.8% Neutral Lipids & Lecithin)
feedMatrices.description: Tofu and soymilk production pulp. Cold sDME extraction strips oil and water without toasted browning reactions, yielding pale, odor-free, high-dietary-fiber soy flour with enhanced water-binding capacity.

feedMatrices.name: Yarrowia lipolytica Single-Cell Oil (SCO) Fermentation Broth (88.0% Initial Moisture, 24.5% Microbial Lipids)
feedMatrices.description: Engineered oleaginous yeast broth accumulating high-purity cocoa butter equivalents and polyunsaturated fatty acids. Direct in-line sDME dewatering eliminates expensive disk-stack centrifuge washing and rotovap desolventization.

solventConditions.name: Pure Liquefied Subcritical DME (0.65 MPa, 25°C, 7.8 wt% H2O solubility, Dipole 1.30 D)
solventConditions.fdaApprovalStatus: FDA 21 CFR § 173.357 GRAS & EU Directive 2009/32/EC Approved Extraction Solvent
solventConditions.hazardLevel: ASHRAE A2 / Flammable Gas (LEL 3.4% - UEL 27.0%) - Full In-Line Hermetic Sealing Required
solventConditions.description: High-purity liquid DME. Due to partial hydrogen bonding with water (7.8 wt% solubility) and strong solvating power for nonpolar triacylglycerols, it extracts water and oil in parallel without thermal drying.

solventConditions.name: Liquefied sDME with 4.0 wt% USP Bio-Ethanol Entrainer (Polar Phospholipid Extraction)
solventConditions.fdaApprovalStatus: FDA 21 CFR § 184.1293 Direct Food Substance GRAS
solventConditions.hazardLevel: Class 1 Flammable Mixture - Requires ATEX Zone 1 Continuous Inerting
solventConditions.description: Engineered co-solvent blend. Incorporating 4 wt% food-grade ethanol enhances polarity, selectively lifting bound polar phospholipids (phosphatidylcholine, phosphatidylethanolamine) from cell membranes.

solventConditions.name: Liquefied sDME / Supercritical CO2 (85:15) Subcritical Blend (Zero-Residue Extraction)
solventConditions.hazardLevel: Pressurized Flammable Gas Blend - Monitored by Infrared Hydrocarbon Sensors
solventConditions.description: Blended solvent offering accelerated flash depressurization and rapid bubble cavitation, accelerating solvent vapor separation during the recovery stage.

solventConditions.name: Conventional High-Temperature n-Hexane Extraction with Thermal Pre-Drying (Severe Fire & Neurotoxic VOC Hazard)
solventConditions.fdaApprovalStatus: Regulated Petrochemical Solvent (Strict OSHA Neurotoxicity PEL 50 ppm)
solventConditions.hazardLevel: HIGH HAZARD: Immiscible with water; requires 2,400 MJ/t thermal pre-drying energy, generates toxic hexane VOC emissions, and risks neurotoxic peripheral neuropathy.
solventConditions.description: Hazardous legacy method requiring extensive fossil-fueled drum drying before extraction, causing severe lipid peroxidation, trans-isomer formation, and dangerous petrochemical fumes.

compressorStages.name: Hermetic Oil-Free Scroll Vapor Recompressor with Water-Cooled Condenser
compressorStages.explosionProofClass: ATEX Zone 1 / NEC Class 1 Div 1 Group D
compressorStages.description: Hermetically sealed scroll compressor without internal lubricating oil. Prevents hydrocarbon contamination of the recycled DME vapor while achieving 99.6% closed-loop solvent condensation.

compressorStages.name: ATEX Zone 1 Explosion-Proof Rotary Screw Recompressor with VFD
compressorStages.explosionProofClass: ATEX Zone 1 Ex d IIB T4 / IECEx
compressorStages.description: Heavy-duty industrial screw compressor featuring variable-frequency inverter control for high-volume automated processing up to 10,000 L/h wet feed throughput.

compressorStages.name: Triple-Diaphragm Hermetic High-Purity Vapor Recompressor
compressorStages.explosionProofClass: Class 1 Div 1 Group D Hermetic Isolated
compressorStages.description: Zero-leakage metallic triple diaphragm compressor designed for infant nutrition and pharmaceutical grade lipids where zero contaminant ingress is mandatory.

compressorStages.name: Uncondensed Atmospheric Solvent Flashing & Open Venting (Severe Explosion Hazard)
compressorStages.description: Catastrophic operational failure: releasing flammable ether gas directly into ambient kitchen or factory air creates an immediate flash-fire cloud and suffocating VOC cloud.
